## Multiple choice questions


Here is an activity (Current supported syntax is a subset of [(quarto) quizdown](https://github.com/parmsam/quarto-quizdown)) 

::: activity-choice
```
#| prompt_key: choice
```
What is the value of `1+1` ($1+1$)?


-   [ ] 1 (i.e the number **one**)
-   [x] 2 
-   [ ] $3$
-   [ ] 4
:::


## Python Lists (multiple choice)
::: activity-choice

What is the value of `x[2]`?

``` python
x = [2, 3, 4]
print(x[2])
```

-   [ ] 1
-   [ ] 2
-   [ ] 3
-   [x] 4
:::


## Text activity

Allow user to type answer freely (exact match answer)

::: activity-text
What does this print?
```python
#| grading: normalized-exact
#| prompt_key: text_hint
#| correct: False
print(0.2+0.1==0.3)
```
:::


Allow user to type answer freely (AI grades answer, unreliable and scary?)

::: activity-text
What does this print?
```python
#| grading: ai
#| prompt_key: text_hint

print(0.2+0.1==0.3)
```
:::


## Compare some prompts...

### Choice

::: activity-choice

What does this python code do?

``` python
#| prompt_key: choice

print(0.2+0.1==0.3)
```

-   [ ] True
-   [x] False
-   [ ] It raises an error
:::
